final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Entry caller frontend logs 98x POST /cart/checkout failures: 'failed to complete the order: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: desc = "transport: Error while dialing: dial tcp: lookup checkoutservice on 169.254.20.10:53: no such host"'. Object layer is otherwise clean: all 11 boutique pods 1/1 Running with RESTARTS 0, no metric alerts, no ResourceQuota object (quota branch excluded), and GetResources(events, namespace=boutique) returns no rows. The named downstream is healthy and therefore not the mechanism: Service checkoutservice exists (10.68.197.55, 5050/TCP) with endpoints bound (172.20.1.137:5050) and CheckServiceConnectivity(checkoutservice:5050) returns open / Connection Succeeded; checkoutservice has no error logs. The real break is the config its calls hang on: GetAppYAML(checkoutservice) sets PRODUCT_CATALOG_SERVICE_ADDR=productcatalogservice:3551, while productcatalogservice exposes 3550 everywhere (PORT=3550, containerPort 3550, probes 3550, Service port 3550 targetPort 3550); probing productcatalogservice:3551 fails while 3550 succeeds, so nothing serves that address. main.go consumes it via mustMapEnv(productCatalogSvcAddr) -> cl.GetProduct() in prepOrderItems, whose error aborts PlaceOrder with 'failed to prepare order'. All other checkout env addresses (shippingservice:50051, paymentservice:50051, emailservice:5000, currencyservice:7000, cartservice:7070) match their Services, isolating this one wrong address as the injected defect.
